promotion.executable_surface: Six curated-external catalog rows advertise the official upstream skills. No repo-vendored skills/chrome-devtools* wrapper copies remain active.
promotion.credential_behavior: No credentials are requested by the audited upstream Markdown skills. MCP browser artifacts, traces, screenshots, Lighthouse reports, and heap snapshots must be kept out of version control.
